title: 第3章 灵根测试第4章 好像闯祸了但真不怪我
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
向上攀爬了大约一个时辰，秦宇来到了一处足足有数个足球场大小的广场上。
广场最里面有着一道拱形石门，石门之上刻着三个恢宏有力的大字。
【玄天宗！
“终于到了，这便是玄天宗的正门吗？”
秦宇好奇观望，广场上密密麻麻全是人，少说也有上万之数。
半空之上还有修者御剑快速靠近，遮天蔽日的灵兽朝这方飞来。
秦宇这才明白，为何一路之上没有遇到天赋超然的天骄。
原来那些大家族的天之骄子都不需要爬山，人家都是直接飞上来的。
虽说平民中也有几率诞生天骄，但概率太小，万中无一！
修仙者的后代，拥有上品、乃至极品灵根的概率更大。
秦宇对准一个坐在青色巨鸟之上的少年，使用了系统的天赋探测。
【距离太远，无法进行探测！
“靠”
秦宇郁闷的找了一处树荫，耐心等待接下来的考核。
……
正午时分！
一声钟鸣从玄天宗深处传出，响彻在天地间。
“要开始了！”
秦宇立刻朝着玄天宗山门的方向凑了过去。
很快，两列身穿青纹白袍，脚踏鎏金长靴的玄天宗弟子整齐走出。

队伍最后跟着一位白眉白须、仙风道骨的老者。
“我是玄天宗二长老胡天，欢迎大家来参加我玄天宗招新考核。”
老者声音并不大，但却有种魔力一般，让在场的所有人都听的清清楚楚。
“这次招收新弟子要求年龄在16岁以下，不符合条件的人可以提前离开。”
“一刻钟后考核正式开始，第一项考核是灵根测试。”
说话间，刚刚出来的玄天宗弟子已经布置好多个测试点。
“参加此次招新考核的小辈们可以开始排队了，陪护人员和无关人员请到广场外静候。”
话音落下，广场上的众人迅速行动起来。
测试点总共布置了十二个，每个测试点有两位玄天宗弟子负责。
content_en:
After climbing up for about an hour, Qin Yu came to a square the size of several football fields.
There is an arched stone gate in the innermost part of the square. Three magnificent and powerful characters are engraved on the stone gate.
【Xuantian Sect!
"We're finally here. Is this the main entrance of Xuantian Sect?"
Qin Yu watched curiously. The square was crowded with people, tens of thousands at least.
There is a cultivator with a sword approaching quickly in mid-air, and a spiritual beast that covers the sky and the sun is flying towards this direction.
Only then did Qin Yu understand why he didn't meet any extraordinary genius along the way.
It turns out that the proud sons of those big families don't need to climb the mountain, they all fly up directly.
Although there is a chance for a genius to be born among civilians, the probability is too small, not even one in ten thousand!
The descendants of immortal cultivators have a greater chance of possessing top-grade or even top-grade spiritual roots.
Qin Yu aimed at a young man sitting on a giant blue bird and used the systematic talent detection.
[The distance is too far to detect!
"Fuck"
Qin Yu found a shade tree in depression and waited patiently for the next assessment.
…
It’s noon!
A bell sounded from the depths of Xuantian Sect, resounding throughout the world.
"It's about to begin!"
Qin Yu immediately moved towards the Xuantian Sect's mountain gate.
Soon, two rows of Xuantian Sect disciples wearing blue-patterned white robes and gilded boots walked out neatly.
At the end of the team was an old man with white eyebrows and white beard, and an immortal spirit.
"I am Hu Tian, the second elder of Xuantian Sect. Welcome everyone to participate in my Xuantian Sect's recruitment assessment."
The old man's voice was not loud, but it had a magical power that could be heard clearly by everyone present.
"The recruitment of new disciples this time requires people under the age of 16. Those who do not meet the requirements can leave early."
"The assessment will officially begin in a quarter of an hour. The first assessment is the spiritual root test."
While talking, the Xuantian Sect disciples who had just come out had already arranged several test points.
"Juniors participating in this recruitment assessment can start queuing up. Accompanying personnel and unrelated personnel please wait outside the square."
As soon as the words fell, everyone in the square took action quickly.
A total of twelve test points were arranged, and two Xuantian Sect disciples were in charge of each test point.
